record_type_quote: Three series including five independent blinded and randomised experiments each were carried out in the same way as in the original study. Only time and conductor of experiments were modified.

targets.evidence_quote: Three series including five independent blinded and randomised experiments each were carried out in the same way as in the original study. Only time and conductor of experiments were modified.
targets.outcome_quote: No specific effects of agitated dilutions of gibberellic acid were found in the first two replication series (p=0.263 and p=0.062). In the third serie with gibbous Lemna gibba L. we observed a significant effect (p=0.009) of the homeopathic treatment, however growth was increased in contrast to decreasing in the former study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The first two series show no original effect and the third shows the opposite direction. The abstract identifies no bibliographic entry for the former study; no target citation is guessed.
